note: BLOCKED: this style's fill is always a real photograph (STYLE.md §1–§2: licence-clean black-and-white photographs, the user's own or CC0 / public-domain files from Wikimedia Commons, printed into the silhouette; "the outline is never filled with a flat colour or a texture"), and its silhouettes come from CC0 vector sources. In this environment every source the style names is unreachable: upload.wikimedia.org, commons.wikimedia.org, images-assets.nasa.gov, www.loc.gov, images.phylopic.org and api.phylopic.org all refuse the connection (checked 2026-11-27), and no photographs of a street, a station or a town were provided with the brief. A procedural "photograph" or a texture fill would be exactly the generic substitute the brief forbids, so nothing was rendered for this style.
short: Its fill is always a real photograph; the photo hosts are refused by this network.
